title: How Hanzo Hasashi became Scorpion in Mortal Kombat
subject: scorpion
description:
Would you have taken Quan Chi's deal? 👇

How a murdered Shirai Ryu ninja came back from the Netherrealm as Scorpion. Spoilers for the Mortal Kombat story.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by NetherRealm Studios or Warner Bros. Games. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Hanzo Hasashi was dead before the first tournament began.
A ninja of Japan's Shirai Ryu clan, he was killed by Bi-Han, the Lin Kuei assassin called Sub-Zero.
In the Netherrealm, the sorcerer Quan Chi offered him a way back, and revenge.
Hanzo returned in fire, with a bladed spear on a rope, as Scorpion.
Quan Chi told him the Lin Kuei had also slaughtered his clan, his wife and his son.
In 1992's Mortal Kombat, he found Bi-Han on Shang Tsung's island and pulled him in with three words: Get over here! Bi-Han never left that island alive.
